evidence.detail: The enum preserves the exact 14 classic client tab constants ATTACK, STATS, QUEST, INVENTORY, EQUIPMENT, PRAYER, MAGIC, CLAN, FRIENDS, IGNORE, LOGOUT, OPTIONS, EMOTES and MUSIC.
Every enum value stores a unique primary integer 0..13 and the static lookup a(int) returns the value whose stored primary id matches the supplied tab id.

The enum is nested under rs/i/b, the reviewed gameframe/adventure-orb renderer that also consumes ChatMessageClassifier while drawing gameframe chat controls; its constants are precisely the client sidebar/tab categories rather than arbitrary gameplay modes.
Each value carries three integer presentation/index metadata values plus a small boolean variant flag, consistent with tab-placement/render metadata; no unrelated domain state exists.

candidates.note: GameframeSidebarTab is a descriptive exact-v308 name fixed by the self-identifying tab constants and integer lookup contract. The separate TOP/BOTTOM nested enum remains unnamed because no surviving behavior consumes it.
